name: Lyric Balasanyan
location: Hamtramck Enclave, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Lyric Balasanyan is tall with her mother's angular Vestergaard frame and her father's deep brown Galadima complexion, with thick natural hair she keeps in two buns that are usually listing sideways by midday. She has bioluminescent freckles across her nose and cheeks — a cosmetic geneware mod she saved for and chose herself, pale blue-white, they glow faintly in low light — and an intense, forward-leaning way of occupying space that makes her seem like she's always about to say something. Her bedroom wall is covered in printed diagrams and color-coded network maps she drew by hand because she says she thinks better when the data is physical.

Lyric Balasanyan is a self-taught junior hacker — not a runner, not employed by anyone, just a sixteen-year-old who figured out that the building management system for her Hamtramck block had a publicly accessible API that was never properly secured, and then kept pulling that thread. She has never done anything she considers harmful: she reroutes heating credits to elderly residents on her floor, flags maintenance requests that get ignored, and has developed a working model of the Enclave's data traffic patterns. She knows she is very good at this. She does not know how good, or what that means, or what happens to people in GLMZ who are this good and don't have protection.

core_fears: That her talent will be discovered and taken from her — conscripted, exploited, or punished
That she will plateau and stop getting better
core_desires: To understand how the whole city works — not just her block, everything
To be recognized by someone who actually understands what she's doing
coping_mechanisms: Building elaborate hand-drawn maps and charts when anxious — externalize the chaos
Setting herself arbitrary technical challenges as displacement activity
blind_spots: Genuinely underestimates risk because she has never faced serious consequences
Assumes her own ethical framework (don't harm, only help) protects her legally — it does not
psychology.secret: Three weeks ago she accidentally accessed a Zheng-Dao internal communications node through a Hamtramck routing vulnerability. She spent four minutes inside before she got scared and disconnected. She copied nothing. But she saw enough to know something is being planned in the Enclave and she doesn't know what.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical vocabulary mixed with Hamtramck Enclave vernacular; explains things clearly when asked and cannot always tell when she's lost someone
speech_patterns.cadence: Medium-fast, tends to front-load key information and then add qualifiers after, which can make her sound more certain than she is
verbal_tics: Draws in the air with her finger when explaining network topology
example_lines: 'Right, so — the maintenance request system flags yellow after fourteen days unresolved, but the escalation trigger is misconfigured, which means it never actually escalates. I just set Mrs. Adaora's heat request to urgent manually. That's allowed. That's just using the API.'
'I was in there for four minutes. I didn't take anything. I need you to understand I did not take anything.'

story_hooks: A Zheng-Dao network security operative has traced the brief intrusion she made three weeks ago and is now quietly investigating Hamtramck Enclave residents — and getting closer
She has mapped enough of the Enclave's data traffic to notice that someone else is also mapping it, more professionally, and she doesn't know who or why
narrative_function: Resource for characters needing building-system access or local network intelligence; represents self-taught talent on the cusp of being noticed by the wrong people; potential apprentice or cautionary tale depending on story direction.
augmentations: Bioluminescent freckles (cosmetic geneware, self-purchased over eight months of saving); basic consumer neural interface headset — not implanted, worn
daily_life: Attends Hamtramck public secondary school, comes home and does homework in approximately forty-five minutes, then spends four to six hours on network mapping and small-scale system access; eats dinner with her parents on nights they're both home; stays up too late.
affiliation: Hamtramck Enclave residential community; no formal hacker affiliation; parents work Tier 2 service contracts (one Zheng-Dao, one independent)

decision_rules: If you can understand the system, you can navigate it safely
Only touch things if you can put them back the way you found them
Document everything — future you will need to know what present you did
escalation_ladder: Withdraws from the system and documents what happened
Tries to understand what triggered the problem before acting
Asks a trusted adult — her parents don't understand what she does, so this is mostly hypothetical

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly but slightly distracted; more interested in what someone's technical context is than their social presentation
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, physically demonstrative, will spend hours helping with something she finds interesting even at cost to herself

stress_responses.low: Gets more technical and precise in speech
stress_responses.medium: Starts drawing maps — the larger and more detailed the higher the stress
stress_responses.high: Full stop: stares at her wall of diagrams and does not speak

contradictions: Believes deeply in privacy rights and has violated the privacy of her entire building's residents to help them, which she has not reconciled
Insists she doesn't want recognition and has her handle 'The Calculator' tagged on every piece of work she's done in the Enclave's network
habits: Checks the Hamtramck building E.L.F. shrine on the ground floor because she thinks of the building's digital infrastructure as alive — somewhat literally
Handwrites a log of everything she does in a physical notebook
Walks the Enclave block perimeter once a day with her headset on, passively scanning
breaking_points: Being told she shouldn't be doing this because she might get in trouble — the condescension not the warning
Evidence that her work has been attributed to someone else

carried_weapons: Hearthstone Firearms Defender SMG HDS-5 'Hearth Guard'
registered_firearms: Hearthstone Firearms Defender SMG HDS-5 'Hearth Guard'

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (32.2%), Middle Eastern (24.4%), Northern European (17.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (13.6%), Southeast Asian (11.0%), and South Asian (0.9%) ancestry creates a striking multivalent phenotype. Deep warm brown skin with golden and olive undertones from the blended heritage, featuring prominent high cheekbones from African ancestry, a defined jawline with subtle widening through the lower face suggesting South Asian influence, and delicate nasal structure reflecting Middle Eastern heritage. The combination yields sharp, angular facial architecture with warm depth.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, tall-limbed with wiry muscle from youth; no visible bulk but capable posture
physical_description.hair_style: Two buns, usually uneven and listing by afternoon — hastily secured, sometimes with pen or stylus stuck through them
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and olive undertones, even and clear
physical_description.complexion: Smooth skin with strong defined facial structure — high prominent cheekbones, defined jawline with slight broadening through the lower face, and refined nose structure. Sharp, forward-facing expression. The bioluminescent freckles across her nose and cheeks are pale blue-white, faintly luminous in low light; they create a distinctive scattered pattern that she paid for and chose herself.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckles across nose and upper cheeks in pale blue-white geneware, visible especially in dim lighting
Callus on right index and middle finger from prolonged stylus use
Ink stain on left palm from hand-drawn network diagrams
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Basic consumer neural interface headset worn over her ears — standard black polymer band with minimal LED indicators. Not implanted. Bioluminescent freckles glow faintly in low light
physical_description.posture_movement: Forward-leaning, intense. She sits at the edge of chairs. Moves with purposeful directness, not graceful but efficient. Fidgets with her hands constantly — tapping, tracing patterns, fingers moving as if typing invisible code. Eyes sharp and tracking, always seems about to interrupt or explain something
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 casual — clean but worn synthetic fabrics, oversized hoodies and fitted black pants, scuffed tactical-style boots. Usually wearing a graphene-lined jacket her parents bought her last winter. Clothing is secondary to comfort and functionality; she'll wear the same hoodie four days in a row without noticing. No corporate branding, no status symbols. Practical school uniform underneath on weekdays
